name: What Remains of Vermin Black
author: Antigravity & Ancient Systems Designer
description: You wake on bare floorboards in an empty room with a single closed door and an identity document bearing your own photograph: Vermin Black. As bulbs pop and impossible corridors fold back upon themselves, hovering shrouds stalk the dark while bloody Roman numerals count down from IX toward an inescapable verdict.

worldIntro.headline: An Empty Room, a Stamped Identity, and a Popped Bulb
worldIntro.text: You wake upon bare floorboards in an empty room with a single closed door. At your feet lies an identity document with your own photograph: Vermin Black. When you open the door and walk through the adjoining chambers, a light bulb pops and you find yourself standing precisely where you woke. As you navigate the repeating architecture, levitating cloths leak toxic dread, music boxes chime in the ash of disappearing entities, and bloody Roman numerals on the central wall count down toward an inescapable accounting in a gilded green armchair.

pillars.label: Impossible Architecture
pillars.detail: Shifting doorways, repeating loops, popped lights, and rooms that dissolve into thin air.

pillars.label: Psychological Accounting
pillars.detail: Crimson Roman numerals descend from IX to zero as past atrocities are confronted.

pillars.label: Detached Survival
pillars.detail: Clinical coldness, pain-killing elixirs, straight razors, and void-tempered lanterns.

startingJournalNotes: Woke in a bare room with one door. Found my identity document on the floor. The room looped back onto itself when the lights popped. The pain is familiar, but the architecture makes no sense.

easy.label: Clinical Detachment (Easy)
easy.desc: Unlimited waking room respawns. Physical and mental composure remain intact upon defeat.

normal.label: The Shifting Loop (Normal)
normal.desc: Unlimited respawns in the waking room; loss of minor loose supplies upon collapse.

hard.label: Fractured Sanity (3 Lives)
hard.desc: Three waking room returns before complete psychological dissolution.

extreme.label: Absolute Void (One Life)
extreme.desc: Permadeath. Falling to the entities permanently seals the doors forever.

factions.name: The Ego
factions.description: Vermin Black's internal composure, clinical detachment, and cognitive defense mechanisms.

factions.name: The Paranormal Entities
factions.description: Paranormal entities, rag emanations, sprinters, and shifting phenomena haunting the architectural loops.

factions.name: The Shifting Space
factions.description: The impossible, shifting labyrinth of rooms, popping light bulbs, popping corridors, and sealed thresholds.

factions.name: The Remembered Victims
factions.description: The echoes of patients, deceived complainants, staff, and butchered animals preserved in the space.

defeatNarrative: A light bulb pops loudly. You open your eyes upon the bare floorboards of the waking room, your identity document resting beside you once again.

stalk.title: Shadow Entity Stalk
stalk.subtitle: Move in rhythm with popping lights and distant footsteps
stalk.successText: You shadow the apparition silently and salvage an intact medicine vial.
stalk.perfectText: Flawless step! You move in perfect silence, retrieving clean elixir and concentrated void ash.
stalk.failText: A floorboard creaks underfoot and the entity vanishes into shadow.

mortar.title: Clinical Compounding Mortar
mortar.subtitle: Grind ash dust and chemical residue into pain-killing tonics
mortar.perfectText: A crystal-clear formulation of pure clarity tonic!

astragaloi.title: The Roman Numerals Cast
astragaloi.subtitle: Roll four stamped ivory blocks upon the polished table

forge.title: Void Crucible Focus
forge.subtitle: Focus lantern rays to temper blood-hardened iron

shield_clash.title: Entity Clashing Brace
shield_clash.subtitle: Brace your trenchcoat against toxic spectral charges

glyph_memory.title: Roman Numeral Afterimage
glyph_memory.subtitle: Repeat the flashing crimson numerals burned onto the projector wall
glyph_memory.successText: Your eyes hold steady through the flicker; Void Ash settles below the lens.
glyph_memory.perfectText: Total clinical recall! A sharp Clarity Crystal condenses in the cold beam.

pendulum_tune.title: Filament Resonance Calibration
pendulum_tune.subtitle: Steady three humming electrical surges before the overhead bulb pops
pendulum_tune.successText: The filament steadies to a cold buzz, dropping jagged glass from the socket.
pendulum_tune.perfectText: Flawless steadiness! A humming Void Crystal Shard drops cleanly into your palm.

transcript.speaker: World Consequence
transcript.text: The distressed father collapses into grey dust, his dispatch voucher fluttering to the floorboards.

addJournalChronicle.title: The Father Erased
addJournalChronicle.text: Eliminated the father's echo in the clinic lobby. He will never seek his daughter again.

transcript.speaker: World Consequence
transcript.text: The Archivist dissolves into scattered manila papers. The archive drawers slide open simultaneously.
